[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6330078][color=#ffffff]CTF Challenge $1000+ Prize Pool [CanYouHack.Me and Virtualine.net][/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Hack Forums has partnered with CanYouHack.Me to launch a new CTF challenge featuring over $1,000 in cash and prizes. Members can compete by completing cybersecurity challenges to earn crypto, permanent L33t or Ub3r upgrades, and an exclusive CYHM award. The event is sponsored by [mention=5555096] completing the “NotBB” 1st challenge will also unlock significant discounts on their hosting services. To participate just visit CanYouHack.Me and register using the Hack Forums account sign in. Every completed challenge moves you closer to qualifying for the larger prize drawings with up to $250 in crypto going to the grand prize winner. Make sure to get your entries in before the deadline on September 9 2026. It's up and running so go test your skills and good luck.

[u][b][size=large]Netflix Restructures Gaming[/size][/b][/u]

Netflix to switch focus from huge expensive video games to party, kids and sports games.

[u][b][size=large]GTA 6 Preorder Anomalies[/size][/b][/u]

89% of people who ordered the new Grand Theft Auto 6 game ahead of time chose the deluxe $100 version instead of the normal cheaper one. A typical industry standard for premium editions sits at just 10–20%.

[u][b][size=large]Mobile Gaming Collapse in Japan[/size][/b][/u]

Japan's mobile gaming sector is experiencing severe financial strain with 10 smartphone game operators declaring bankruptcy.

[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=5458992]

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]Getting Older, Getting Wiser[/size][/b][/color]

Getting older is something none of us can stop. Years pass quietly, and one day we realize how much has changed—people we once saw every day are gone, old dreams have been replaced by new ones, and the things we once worried about no longer seem important.

We spend so much of our lives wishing to be older, then later wishing we could go back. But growing older isn't something to fear. It's a reminder that our time is limited, and that every ordinary day is actually part of a life we will one day look back on.

You don't need to stay young forever. You just need to make sure that when you look back, you have more memories than regrets.

Getting older means losing some things—but it also means gaining perspective, wisdom, and a better understanding of what truly matters.

[hr]

[color=#FF851B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]

Don't waste today wishing you were younger. Enjoy the age you're at, because you'll never be this age again.

[hr]

[color=#008E02][size=15]Quote of the week[/size][/color]

“Age is an issue of mind over matter. If you don't mind, it doesn't matter.”
— Mark Twain
